scope: Physical UIKit coordinates when a new touch interrupts a coast. At recycle, the expected offset equals the previous offset minus the column shift. At first subsequent finger movement, signed content motion plus signed finger motion should be near zero. Edge resistance and coalesced inputs can contribute small differences. Values are points; a full column measures 353 points in iPhone portrait or 694 points in landscape. Dates and fixes are checked separately; callbacks are not displayed-frame timestamps.
